::: {#def-r-squared}
#### Coefficient of determination

The **coefficient of determination** of a model fitted with parameter estimate $\est{\vparam}$
is one minus the ratio of its [residual sum of squares](#def-rss) at $\est{\vparam}$
to the [total sum of squares](#def-tss) of its outcomes:

$$R^2 \eqdef 1 - \frac{\text{RSS}(\est{\vparam})}{\text{TSS}}.$$
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: {#rem-r-squared-interpretation}
#### Interpreting the coefficient of determination

$R^2$ is often described as the proportion of the variation in $Y$
explained by the regression on $X$.
:::
